headers.DKIM-Signature: v=1; a=rsa-sha256; d=enterprise.com; s=selector1; c=relaxed/relaxed; h=from:to:subject:date; bh=abc123def456...

email.body:
Dear Employees,

As part of our ongoing commitment to security, please update your network passwords by the end of this week using the official internal portal at https://portal.enterprise.com/password-update.

This is a routine security measure to protect your accounts.

Thank you,
IT Security Team

indicators: Email sent from verified internal IT domain with valid SPF and DKIM signatures.
No suspicious attachments or links to external untrusted domains.
User accessed the official internal password update portal over HTTPS.
Login and email access timestamps consistent with working hours.
Network traffic shows encrypted SMTP and HTTPS connections within corporate network.
samples.activity_type: Legitimate internal IT communication and user credential update process
samples.business_justification: Periodic password update reminders are standard security best practices to reduce risk of credential compromise and comply with enterprise security policies.

samples.scenario: IT department sends an internal email to all employees reminding them to update their passwords via the official company portal.
